categories.name: AI & Technology
categories.focus: AI research and products, AI agents and agentic tooling, coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, vibe coding), the major labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind), and AI hardware such as Nvidia GPUs. ALSO include Elon Musk's technology ventures (Tesla, xAI/Grok, Neuralink) — but his rocket and satellite news belongs to Space & Astronomy, not here. ALSO include AI used inside video games: AI-driven NPCs, AI characters and companions, and generative or procedural systems used as core game mechanics. Do NOT include ordinary gaming news (game releases, reviews, hardware, industry business) that has no AI angle. Include notable general technology developments.

categories.name: Science & Research
categories.focus: Scientific research and discoveries: physics, quantum, biology, chemistry, and the natural world. ALSO include biomedical and medical RESEARCH — new studies, clinical trial results, drug and treatment breakthroughs, and discoveries about disease mechanisms. STRICTLY EXCLUDE the non-research side of health: disease outbreaks and public-health bulletins, healthcare policy, insurance, hospitals, regulatory approvals, and pharmaceutical industry business news. Exclude space and astronomy, which have their own category.

categories.name: World News & Geopolitics
categories.focus: Global affairs in one place: major world news and international events; armed conflicts, military and defense developments, NATO, diplomacy and sanctions; US politics including the Trump administration and Congress; and German and EU politics (Bundestag, AfD, Sonneborn, Brussels and European Commission decisions). Prioritise the most consequential developments — do not pad with minor items.

categories.name: Investing & Markets
categories.focus: Stock markets, company earnings, macroeconomics, central banks (Fed/ECB), and investing trends.

categories.name: Space & Astronomy
categories.focus: Rocket launches and spaceflight (including SpaceX, Starship and Starlink), NASA/ESA missions, astronomy discoveries, telescopes, and planetary science.

categories.name: Energy
categories.focus: Energy technology and deployment: renewables (solar, wind), nuclear fission, and emerging energy tech such as fusion, plus grid and storage. Focus on the technology and industry, NOT climate policy or emissions debates.
